from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialOtherPayables(BaseModel):
    """One company's other payables amount from their financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name reported in this document")
    other_payables_amount: float | None = Field(description="The 'other payables' amount reported in this document")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The financial reporting period")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short excerpt showing the line item")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_other_payables: list[FinancialOtherPayables]
